settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Set in the heading face in the header, the menu and the footer. Leave empty to use the site name.

settings.label: Tagline
settings.info: The line under the wordmark in the header and the footer.

settings.label: Reveal on scroll
settings.info: Cards, stats and photos fade up as the page scrolls. Never the first screen.

settings.label: Heading case
settings.info: The display line and the headings in capitals, or as typed.

settings.label: Phone
settings.info: Printed as typed; the call links drop the spaces.

settings.label: Phone line
settings.info: The short promise under the phone number.

settings.label: Emergency phone
settings.info: A second number for out-of-hours calls. Leave empty to use the phone.

settings.label: Ask button
settings.info: The theme takes requests, not bookings. Link sends every ask button to your own scheduling page.

settings.label: Ask link
settings.info: Where the ask button goes when it follows a link, and without JavaScript.

settings.label: Confirm line
settings.default: We call back within one business hour

settings.label: Rating
settings.info: Your average, typed as it should read: 4.9. Leave empty to hide the rating pill.

settings.label: Review link
settings.info: Where Read all goes: your reviews page or profile.

settings.label: Licence lines
settings.info: One licence or registration per line. Printed in the footer and the story.

settings.label: Call bar on phones
settings.info: A bar fixed to the bottom of the screen on phones: Call and the ask button.

settings.label: Address
settings.info: Used when you have no location entry. One line per line.
